name: Forced Labour in Supply Chains and Employment
description: Labour obtained through coercion, deception, debt bondage, wage withholding, document retention or threats. Businesses and financial institutions encounter risks via labour intermediaries, suppliers in high-risk sectors and unusual wage patterns. Controls combine supply-chain due diligence with worker-centred escalation.

sources.text: ILO, Profits and Poverty: The Economics of Forced Labour (2014)
OECD, Due Diligence Guidance for Responsible Business Conduct (2018)
FATF and APG, Financial Flows from Human Trafficking (2018)

indicators.name: Recruitment fees charged to workers
indicators.desc: Payments from workers to recruiters or employers for placement, visas or training, creating debt.
indicators.ctx: Payments from workers to recruiters or employers for placement, visas or training, creating debt.
indicators.fp: Fees may be legitimately borne by employers in compliant models.

indicators.name: Wages paid to accounts controlled by employer or agent
indicators.canon: Account controlled or used by someone other than the holder
indicators.desc: Signs that a third party holds the card, PIN, credentials or device, or that funds and activity belong to someone other than the named holder.
indicators.ctx: Workers' pay lands in accounts accessed by employer, with cards held by employer or agent.
indicators.fp: Some employers manage accounts for migrant workers with consent.

indicators.name: Unusually low wages, deductions or accommodation charges
indicators.canon: Unusually low wages, deductions or accommodation charges
indicators.desc: Pay after deductions is far below minimum wage standards; heavy deductions for housing, food and transport.
indicators.ctx: Pay after deductions is far below minimum wage standards; heavy deductions for housing, food and transport.
indicators.fp: Statutory deductions and employer housing are lawful.

indicators.name: Suppliers in sectors or regions with high forced-labour risk
indicators.canon: Suppliers in sectors or regions with high forced-labour risk
indicators.desc: Sourcing from sectors such as agriculture, fishing, garments or mining in regions flagged by credible reports.
indicators.ctx: Sourcing from sectors such as agriculture, fishing, garments or mining in regions flagged by credible reports.
indicators.fp: Most suppliers in these areas comply.

indicators.name: Labour provider with no registration or opaque ownership
indicators.canon: Labour provider with no registration or opaque ownership
indicators.desc: Unlicensed gangmaster supplying workers, with nominee owners and frequent name changes.
indicators.ctx: Unlicensed gangmaster supplying workers, with nominee owners and frequent name changes.

indicators.name: Document retention or restricted movement reported
indicators.canon: Document retention or restricted movement reported
indicators.desc: Audit or customer information indicates passports withheld, workers housed on site or unable to leave.
indicators.ctx: Audit or customer information indicates passports withheld, workers housed on site or unable to leave.
indicators.fp: Employers may safeguard documents at workers' request in limited cases.

indicators.name: Adverse media or import bans related to supplier
indicators.canon: Adverse media or intelligence linking counterparties to criminal activity
indicators.desc: Counterparties, suppliers, respondents or controllers appear in adverse media, law-enforcement notices or intelligence connected to financial crime, abuse, forced labour or organised crime.
indicators.ctx: Credible allegations or customs detentions connected with forced labour.

indicators.name: Payment of workers in cash with no payroll records
indicators.canon: Payment of workers in cash with no payroll records
indicators.desc: Large cash payroll withdrawals with no tax or social contributions.
indicators.ctx: Large cash payroll withdrawals with no tax or social contributions.
indicators.fp: Informal economy may lawfully include cash wages.

indicators.name: Seasonal worker mass remittance to few beneficiaries
indicators.canon: Seasonal worker mass remittance to few beneficiaries
indicators.desc: Many workers all send funds to one recipient in home country.
indicators.ctx: Many workers all send funds to one recipient in home country.
indicators.fp: Workers from one village may send to a single trusted agent.
